ThingDef.label: Econo-Save Plink-Protect™
ThingDef.description: Increases base body armour by 5% by making the body denser. Causes organs to harden slightly in response to physical trauma.

ThingDef.label: Junker's Lattice
ThingDef.description: This lattice implant was manufactured improperly. It is still semi-usable, but does not interact well with the host, causing pain, numbness in the fingers, and various other ailments when implanted.

ThingDef.label: mercenary armour implant
ThingDef.description: This implant covers the skin in a thin, self-replicating lattice that protects against initial damage.

ThingDef.label: juggernaut armour implant
ThingDef.description: This implant injects a biological, metal-like substance that fills the body and prevents significant damage on impact. It can be installed in multiple organs for a reinforcing effect.

ThingDef.label: x-lattice implant
ThingDef.description: The X-Lattice implant. Significantly enhances the user's resistance to physical trauma through an advanced lattice structure.\n\nIt is part of the X Series of implants. It is crafted by wasteland engineers and surviving Secronom scientists using available modern technology and junkyard materials in order to provide a cheap physical enhancement for survivors who could not afford the higher end implants.

ThingDef.label: mercenary resistance implant
ThingDef.description: This implant extends a weak psionic field throughout the entire body, increasing its density and resilience to damage. The design was created by reverse-engineering an extremely powerful Vacuous-grade implant and copying the psionic field. The materials aren't sufficient for the full field, but this implant is valuable nonetheless.

ThingDef.label: pain resistance-core implant
ThingDef.description: There is no strength without suffering. This implant can be installed on all body parts. It is cheap and abundant. It requires no medical skill. But it is incredibly difficult to install.

ThingDef.label: mercenary focus implant
ThingDef.description: This implant reduces the need for sleep and recreation, allowing a soldier to focus purely on the battle in front of them.

ThingDef.label: Econo-Save Muscle Maker implant
ThingDef.description: Increases muscle density to increase kinetic melee strikes by 5% force

ThingDef.label: Junker's Steroid Injector implant
ThingDef.description: This implant was made to increase strength and melee damage, but a manufacturing defect causes it to have the side effect of greatly increasing susceptibility to pain and limiting dexterity.

ThingDef.label: military piercing implant
ThingDef.description: This implant is designed for melee specialists, allowing them to strike through significantly more powerful armor than they might otherwise penetrate.

ThingDef.label: military rapid-hit implant
ThingDef.description: This implant is designed for melee hitters and increases their attack speed.

ThingDef.label: military strike force implant
ThingDef.description: This implant is designed for heavy melee hitters and allows them to increase their damage with stronger hits.

ThingDef.label: pain melee-core implant
ThingDef.description: There is no strength without suffering. This implant can be installed on all body parts. It is cheap and abundant. It requires no medical skill. But it is incredibly difficult to install.

ThingDef.label: x-speed melee core
ThingDef.description: The X-Speed Melee Core implant. Dramatically enhances the user's melee attack speed through advanced neural enhancements and muscle fiber optimization, reducing attack cooldown by 95%.\n\nIt is part of the X Series of implants. It is crafted by wasteland engineers and surviving Secronom scientists using available modern technology and junkyard materials.

ThingDef.label: x-strength melee core
ThingDef.description: The X-Strength Melee Core implant. Dramatically enhances the user's melee combat capabilities through neural enhancements and muscle fiber optimization.\n\nIt is part of the X Series of implants. It is crafted by wasteland engineers and surviving Secronom scientists using available modern technology and junkyard materials in order to provide a cheap physical enhancement for survivors who could not afford the higher end implants.

ThingDef.label: prototype glass cannon implant
ThingDef.description: This implant was discovered in an escaped mutated soldier several miles outside of a Vacuous research facility. It grants the wearer immense strength and speed but extreme vulnerability to damage and pain.

ThingDef.label: prototype tank implant
ThingDef.description: An incredibly powerful tank implant found on a frozen 2-story creature. The creature had been obliterated by a Vacuous blast but was still standing upright with the hole in its body.

ThingDef.label: Aim-Quick implant
ThingDef.description: This implant adds momentary bursts of sensation to the fingers and enhances targeting, reducing the time needed to aim while retaining accuracy.

ThingDef.label: Junker's Blaster implant
ThingDef.description: This implant was designed to provide soldiers better shooting accuracy and focus by slowing muscle movement, but a manufacturing defect causes the shooter to move extremely slowly.

ThingDef.label: mercenary sniper implant
ThingDef.description: This implant changes how a soldier perceives distance, space, and movement, allowing them to fire with significantly increased accuracy.

ThingDef.label: military sniping implant
ThingDef.description: This implant is designed for sniping specialists, allowing them to hit targets better at extremely long ranges.

ThingDef.label: military quickscope implant
ThingDef.description: This implant is designed for sniping specialists, allowing them to hit targets better at extremely long ranges.

ThingDef.label: solo chip implant
ThingDef.description: This all-in one implant is standard for most military soldiers. If they survive the procedure, they are ready for more specialized implants.

ThingDef.label: survivalist aid implant
ThingDef.description: This implant injects a biological, metal-like substance that fills the organ it is installed in, causing the organ to grow denser and allowing it to take extra damage before being destroyed. It can be installed in any organ.

ThingDef.label: warrior module implant
ThingDef.description: A common military implant used by raiders. It is constantly harvested from battlefields.

ThingDef.label: x-shield tier 1 implant
ThingDef.description: The X-Shield tier 1 implant. A basic defensive enhancement that improves sharp damage resistance by 10%.\n\nIt is part of the X Series of implants.

ThingDef.label: x-shield tier 2 implant
ThingDef.description: The X-Shield tier 2 implant. An improved defensive enhancement that provides 25% damage resistance, 25 HP, and increased pain threshold.\n\nIt is part of the X Series of implants.

ThingDef.label: x-shield tier 3 implant
ThingDef.description: The X-Shield tier 3 implant. An advanced defensive enhancement providing 50% damage resistance, 75 HP, improved pain threshold, and enhanced immune system.\n\nIt is part of the X Series of implants.

ThingDef.label: x-shield tier 4 implant
ThingDef.description: The X-Shield tier 4 implant. A superior defensive enhancement providing 100% damage resistance, 150 HP, greatly improved pain threshold, enhanced immune system, and increased speed.\n\nIt is part of the X Series of implants.

ThingDef.label: x-shield tier 5 implant
ThingDef.description: The X-Shield tier 5 implant. An ultimate defensive enhancement providing 200% damage resistance, 250 HP, near-immunity to pain, massively enhanced immune system, greatly increased speed, and improved combat capabilities.\n\nIt is part of the X Series of implants.

ThingDef.label: x-shield tier 11 implant (Experimental)
ThingDef.description: The X-Shield tier 11 Experimental implant. A highly unstable but incredibly powerful enhancement that adds 100 HP to every body part and provides massive stat boosts across the board. The technology is barely understood and extremely dangerous to produce.\n\nIt is the pinnacle of the X Series of implants, created through forbidden research and desperate measures.
